title: Multi-Instrumentalist
blurb: Piano (ABRSM Grade 8, Classical Pianist @ Jakarta International Summer Music Festival 2017, 100+ performances), Guitar (Classical/Acoustic/Electric, 70+ performances, Guitarist @ VISENSE, JFP, etc.), Bass (Electric bass, 50+ performances, Bassist @ Mission House Baywalk & others), Kolintang (Bulan Bahasa 2023 @ SPH), Flute (Indonesian Representative @ ACSC Hong Kong), various other instruments. Performances with audiences ranging from 100-2,000 people. Performed at national monuments, international concert halls, local radio, & at various types of events.
